SELECT todo_id, title, start_date, end_date, is_recurring, 'regular' as type FROM t_todo WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND ( (start_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR (end_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) )
UNION ALL
SELECT todo_id, title, start_date, completed_at as end_date, is_recurring, 'completed' as type FROM t_todo_completed WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND completed_at BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
UNION ALL
SELECT todo_id, '미완료: ' || todo_id as title, original_date as start_date, missed_date as end_date, 'N' as is_recurring, 'missed' as type FROM t_todo_missed WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND missed_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT todo_id, member_id, title, detail, start_date, end_date, is_recurring, created_at, updated_at FROM t_todo WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY start_date DESC

SELECT t.todo_id as todoId, t.member_id as memberId, t.title, t.detail, CASE WHEN t.is_recurring = 'Y' THEN t.start_date + (7 * FLOOR((TRUNC(SYSDATE) - t.start_date)/7)) ELSE t.start_date END as startDate, t.end_date as endDate, t.is_recurring as isRecurring, t.created_at as createdAt FROM t_todo t WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND ( (t.is_recurring = 'N' AND TRUNC(t.start_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) OR (t.is_recurring = 'Y' AND MOD(TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(t.start_date), 7) = 0) ) ORDER BY startDate

SELECT todo_id, member_id, title, detail, start_date, end_date, is_recurring, created_at, updated_at FROM t_todo WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND ( (start_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR (end_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) )

SELECT t.todo_id, t.member_id, t.title, t.detail, TO_CHAR(t.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as start_date, TO_CHAR(t.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as end_date, t.is_recurring, r.repeat_interval, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM t_todo t LEFT JOIN t_todo_recurring r ON t.todo_id = r.todo_id WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND ( (t.is_recurring = 'N' AND TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN t.start_date AND t.end_date) OR (t.is_recurring = 'Y' AND r.repeat_interval > 0 AND TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= r.repeat_start AND (r.repeat_end IS NULL OR TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= r.repeat_end) AND MOD(TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - r.repeat_start, r.repeat_interval) = 0) ) ORDER BY t.start_date
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_todo ( todo_id, member_id, title, detail, start_date, end_date, is_recurring, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( TODO_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{detail}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{isRecurring}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
SELECT TODO_SEQ.CURRVAL FROM DUAL

INSERT INTO t_todo_recurring ( recurring_id, todo_id, member_id, repeat_type, repeat_interval, repeat_start, repeat_end, created_at ) VALUES ( RECURRING_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{todoId}, #{memberId}, #{repeatType}, #{repeatInterval}, TO_DATE(#{repeatStart}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
TO_DATE(#{repeatEnd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
NULL,
SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO t_todo_completed ( todo_id, member_id, title, detail, start_date, end_date, completed_at, is_recurring, repeat_interval ) SELECT t.todo_id, t.member_id, t.title, t.detail, t.start_date, t.end_date, SYSDATE, t.is_recurring, r.repeat_interval FROM t_todo t LEFT JOIN t_todo_recurring r ON t.todo_id = r.todo_id WHERE t.todo_id = #{todoId} AND t.member_id = #{memberId}

INSERT INTO T_TODO_MISSED ( MISSED_ID, TODO_ID, MEMBER_ID, ORIGINAL_DATE, MISSED_DATE ) SELECT MISSED_SEQ.NEXTVAL, t.todo_id, t.member_id, t.end_date, SYSDATE FROM T_TODO t LEFT JOIN T_TODO_COMPLETED tc ON t.todo_id = tc.todo_id LEFT JOIN T_TODO_MISSED tm ON t.todo_id = tm.todo_id WHERE t.end_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND tc.todo_id IS NULL AND tm.todo_id IS NULL

INSERT INTO T_TODO_MISSED ( MISSED_ID, TODO_ID, MEMBER_ID, ORIGINAL_DATE, MISSED_DATE ) SELECT MISSED_SEQ.NEXTVAL, t.todo_id, t.member_id, t.end_date, SYSDATE FROM T_TODO t LEFT JOIN T_TODO_COMPLETED tc ON t.todo_id = tc.todo_id LEFT JOIN T_TODO_MISSED tm ON t.todo_id = tm.todo_id WHERE t.end_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND t.member_id = #{memberId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tc.todo_id IS NULL AND tm.todo_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT m.*, t.title, t.detail FROM t_todo_missed m JOIN t_todo t ON m.todo_id = t.todo_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY m.missed_date DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_todo t WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.end_date = TRUNC(SYSDATE-1) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_todo_completed tc WHERE tc.todo_id = t.todo_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_todo_missed tm WHERE tm.todo_id = t.todo_id AND tm.original_date = t.end_date )
SELECT todo_id, member_id, title, detail, start_date, end_date, completed_at FROM t_todo_completed WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY completed_at DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE t_todo SET title = #{title}, detail = #{detail}, start_date = TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), end_date = TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), is_recurring = #{isRecurring}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
